verses.1: Therefore, we no longer wished to remain in Athens alone.
verses.2: And we have sent Timothy, our brother and partner in the gospel of Christ, to help you and to encourage your faith.
verses.3: Do not let anything be lost in these times of sorrow. You knew well that we were destined to face this situation.
verses.4: And indeed, when we were with you, we foresaw that we would suffer, and as it happened, you also knew that.
verses.5: Therefore, I no longer send out messages to you in order to test your faith. Otherwise, the one who tests you will be left empty-handed.
verses.6: And when Timotheus came to us, away from you, and proclaimed to us your faith and love, and that you always remember us with good deeds, so that we may see you just as we see you ourselves.
verses.7: Therefore, brothers, we have come to you in all our needs and sorrows due to your faith.
verses.8: Because we will live now, if you stand with us in this situation.
verses.9: For how much kindness we have received from the God, we are willing to repay you with all the joy that we can. We rejoice in your presence before God.
verses.10: Do we spend nights and days trying to see your faces and understand the nature of your beliefs?
verses.11: May the Lord, our Father and Lord Jesus, guide us along the path towards you.
verses.12: But our Lord wants us to be more loving and devoted to each other, as well as to all people around us. Just as we love you, so should you love us.
verses.13: That your hearts may be established in holiness, before God and our Father, in the presence of our Lord Jesus, along with all those who are holy to Him.
